title: Understanding Drainage Pipe Materials and Applications
description: Choosing the right pipe material is critical for the long-term performance of any drainage system. Different materials offer distinct advantages depending on whether they are installed underground, inside building walls, or handling high-temperature discharge. Common options like PVC, ABS, and cast iron each have specific joining methods, expansion characteristics, and structural strengths. Professional installers must evaluate site conditions, local code requirements, and chemical exposure risks before selecting a material. Knowing how each pipe type reacts to stress and environment ensures a resilient, leak-free drainage network that lasts for decades.

Professional installers must evaluate site conditions, local code requirements, and chemical exposure risks before selecting a material. Knowing how each pipe type reacts to stress and environment ensures a resilient, leak-free drainage network that lasts for decades.
